## Who I Am {data-i18n="home.who-title"}

::: {data-i18n="home.who"}
I am a software engineer and technologist driven by a passion for solving complex, real-world operational challenges. Grounded in a strong scientific foundation from my studies in Pure Physics and Computer Science at USM, I approach system design with analytical rigour and structured problem-solving. My core focus lies in architecting robust digital infrastructure connecting edge devices, enterprise software, and modern AI automation.
:::

## What I Do {data-i18n="home.what-title"}

::: {data-i18n="home.what-intro"}
Currently, my work revolves around building and modernising scalable enterprise solutions across:
:::

::: {.text-left-justify data-i18n="home.what-list"}

- **Industrial IoT & AI Integration:** Modernising industrial workflows, combining IoT edge data with SaaS platforms, and deploying AI-integrated systems.
- **Enterprise Ecosystems:** Developing and sustaining Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ERP solutions, and Management Information Systems (MIS).
- **System Optimisation & Reliability:** Managing and refining legacy systems to achieve maximum stability. Through targeted engineering and modernisation, I reduced client support tickets by 98% (lowering maintenance overhead from high volume down to just 1–2 tickets per month).
:::
